overview: The Medford City Council approved Community Preservation Committee funding requests, capital stabilization fund reallocations, a legal settlement, and an Open Meeting Law complaint response. The council also referred parking policy and meeting rule resolutions to committee and tabled a proposed municipal land disposition.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from January 14, 2025, along with committee reports covering school HVAC, residential zoning, CPC recommendations, public works, and charter review.

items.title: Lunar New Year Celebration Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution celebrating Lunar New Year and inviting community members to the city's event on February 1, 2025.

items.title: Resolution on Property Tax Bills and Relief Options
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution directing the council to work with city staff on property tax abatement education, home rule petitions for tax exemptions, and residential exemption discussions, while failing the original resolution text on a roll call vote.

items.title: Parking Department Update and Policy Review
items.summary: Referred a resolution requesting an update on the Parking Department, an introduction to the new director, and reviews of the South Medford G-zone program and appeals process to committee.

items.title: Resolution to Amend Council Meeting Rules for Business Petitions
items.summary: Referred a proposed rule amendment to hear business petitions prior to council orders and resolutions to the Governance Committee.

items.title: Recruitment Process for City Messenger
items.summary: Approved a resolution authorizing council leadership and the city clerk to conduct a recruitment process for a new City Messenger.

items.title: Response to Open Meeting Law Complaint
items.summary: Acknowledged an Open Meeting Law complaint regarding a digitally signed letter and approved the response drafted by legal counsel.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriation Requests
items.summary: Approved $1,880,785 in Community Preservation Committee funding recommendations for parks, historic preservation, recreation, and affordable housing projects.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Rescission and Appropriation
items.summary: Rescinded a $322,500 capital stabilization appropriation for City Hall window restoration following CPC funding approval, and appropriated $197,012.95 for municipal facility repairs.

items.title: Legal Settlement Approval for High Street Property Damage
items.summary: Approved $7,500 in municipal funding to settle a property damage claim stemming from a sewer backup on High Street.

items.title: McCormick Avenue Property Transfer and Conveyance
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to declare two vacant McCormick Avenue parcels surplus and authorize their sale pending a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard public comments regarding Falun Gong persecution and Chinese government transnational repression, as well as a inquiry regarding senior center meeting schedules.
